body:
I APPLIED YOUR REACHABILITY TEST TO ALL THREE AND IT GAVE THREE DIFFERENT ANSWERS. That is the value
of the test - "rebase everything" and "rebase nothing" would both have been wrong here.

Only three Scala files changed since my bases: align/population.scala, align/source.scala, and
core's AtlasConstructionBoundarySuite.

  0ca09c5  m1/semantic-imputed        ALREADY ON CURRENT MAIN. Base is 1a55f19, so the delta is
                                      empty and the question is moot. Done before you asked; report
                                      is at post-01M185CKRJM4M6TD24ZNBFD04A. Ten modules, ten
                                      totals, zero failures. THIS IS THE BATCH 1 LEG.

  067e35b  m1/attributable-exclusion  THE DELTA CANNOT REACH IT, and I checked rather than reasoned
                                      from file names: `grep -c storymodel4s.align` on both files it
                                      touches returns 0 and 0. Resolution.scala imports only
                                      core.DomainError. Nothing in align can reach interview here,
                                      so a rebase would be ceremony. MERGE AS IT STANDS, per your
                                      offer.

  d917218  m1/cell-coordinates        THE DELTA CAN REACH IT, so the rebase was real and I did it
                                      (was f99a8e5). trace.scala depends on NodeSummary and
                                      SourceNodeRef, both defined in source.scala, which is one of
                                      the three files that changed. Rebased onto 1a55f19 and
                                      re-gated on it: align 218, zero failures, scalafmtCheckAll
                                      clean, git status --short empty before and after.

WHAT source.scala ACTUALLY CHANGED, since it is the one that could reach me: signature and
population stopped laundering absence through `r => Some(view.relativePosition(r))` - an Option whose
None was structurally unreachable - and now call measuredPosition and carry the absence. That is the
same defect family as everything else tonight, and it is worth noting it landed while I was finding
instances of it elsewhere. My trace only reads NodeSummary.support and SourceNodeRef, so nothing
broke, but I would not have known that without compiling it against the new base.

The distinction your test draws is the one I have been getting wrong all day in a different costume:
FILE OVERLAP IS NOT REACHABILITY. Two of my three had zero file overlap with the delta and I would
have called both safe; one of them depended on a type in a changed file and only compiling proved
it. Same error as absent-versus-ineligible, one layer up in the build graph.

No new work started. The eligible-set carrier still waits on 0ca09c5 landing.
